radar_fcs.tooltip.fcs: Works with the equipment of its radar network: CBC mounts with aim controllers, Create Radars radars, monitors, memory blocks. Needs power (FE). RMB: settings and status, Shift+RMB: hold fire
radar_fcs.tooltip.transponder: IFF: right-click to set the code, the selection mode (sublevel, radius, or sublevel and distance) and the radius. Everything in the zone is friendly: mobs, players, vehicles, projectiles, ships. A fire control treats it as friendly if its code list (IFF tab) accepts the code. Needs power (FE). Dye only changes the colour
radar_fcs.report.radar_missing: no running radar on a link
radar_fcs.tooltip.monitor: Target screen fed by Create Radars radars of its radar network: friendly, hostile, inactive. RMB on a blip designates it for the network's fire controls (manual aiming), Shift+RMB opens the monitor window: target list, filters, scale. Build as a wall. Needs power (FE): 32 FE/t per screen block
radar_fcs.status.no_power: no rotation on the aim controller
radar_fcs.report.spread: [CBC spread ±%s°: longer barrel or fewer charges]
radar_fcs.gui.title: Fire Control Computer
radar_fcs.gui.fire_hint.single: One shot, then a pause. Fires only when the predicted miss is within tolerance. 20 ticks = 1 s.
radar_fcs.gui.fire_hint.auto: Continuous fire while the predicted miss is within tolerance.
radar_fcs.gui.fire_hint.burst: A burst of the set length, then a pause. Counts projectiles that left the barrel. 20 ticks = 1 s.
radar_fcs.gui.targets_hint: Sublevels are Sable / Create Aeronautics ships; entities are Create contraptions, projectiles, rockets, boats, minecarts and the rest. Priority level: higher wins. Speed in m/s, "off" means no limit.
radar_fcs.gui.drop_hint: A dropped target is ignored. Static means slower than the server minSpeed for longer than the standing time (a short stop such as a turn is not static yet; a target that never moved is static at once). Shots are counted over all mounts; saving settings brings dropped targets back.
radar_fcs.gui.pick_hint: Type level first, then the priority mode. Each mount picks on its own. Switching moves fire to another target and cycles through the left ones; with a single target fire continues. A target designated on the monitor goes first.
radar_fcs.tooltip.radar_link: Goes on equipment and adds it to a radar network, like a Stock Link. Placed untuned it starts a new network; RMB an existing link to tune to its network. Unlimited range, full redstone power disables it. Reset: Shift+RMB in air or in a crafting grid
radar_fcs.link.cleared: Cleared connection to the radar network
radar_fcs.link.not_linked: Link is not on a network
radar_fcs.tooltip.yaw_controller: Place directly under a CBC cannon mount and feed rotation from below. Turns the cannon horizontally by the needed angle; shaft speed sets the turn rate (256 RPM = 192°/s)
radar_fcs.tooltip.pitch_controller: Place directly beside a CBC cannon mount and feed rotation from the other side. Elevates the barrel by the needed angle; shaft speed sets the rate
radar_fcs.controller.no_mount_yaw: No mount: place it directly under a CBC cannon mount
radar_fcs.controller.no_mount_pitch: No mount: place it directly beside a CBC cannon mount
radar_fcs.link.place_on_equipment: A radar link goes on equipment: computer, CBC mount, radar or monitor
radar_fcs.link.tooltip_untuned: Not tuned: when placed it starts a new network. RMB an existing link to join its network
radar_fcs.link.disabled: Radar network %s: link disabled by redstone
radar_fcs.link.network_info: Radar network %s: fire controls %s, cannons %s, radars %s, monitors %s, memory %s
radar_fcs.gui.hostile_only: Mobs: hostile only (passive ones via the whitelist)
radar_fcs.gui.lists_hint: Entry: entity ID (minecraft:cow), type tag (#minecraft:undead), every entity of a mod (create:*) or the name of a player, ship or name-tagged entity. Whitelist: always a target, even if its type is off or the mob is passive; blacklist: never. Transponder friends and server limits override the lists.
radar_fcs.gui.assemble_hint: Assemble every cannon of this fire control now; afterwards it assembles them by itself again
radar_fcs.gui.disassemble_hint: Disassemble every cannon of this fire control (e.g. to rebuild it); it will not assemble them until "Assemble" is pressed
radar_fcs.monitor_gui.title: Radar Monitor
radar_fcs.monitor_gui.no_radar: No Create Radars radar in the monitor's network
radar_fcs.monitor_gui.hint: Click a target to designate it to the network's fire controls (manual aiming), click again to clear. On the in-world screen: right-click a blip.
radar_fcs.monitor_gui.coords: X %s Y %s Z %s, range %s m, height %s m, %s m/s
radar_fcs.gui.iff_mode_white: Mode: whitelist — only transponders with listed codes are friendly
radar_fcs.gui.iff_mode_black: Mode: blacklist — every transponder is friendly except listed codes
radar_fcs.gui.iff_hidden: Codes are hidden: only the fire control's owner, their team and operators see and change them.
radar_fcs.gui.iff_hint_white: Whitelist: a transponder is friendly only if its code is listed; transponders without a code or with other codes are hostile (protect nothing). Enter the code in the transponder too (right-click it). The owner, their team and friendlyPlayers are always friendly.
radar_fcs.gui.iff_hint_black: Blacklist: every transponder (also without a code) is friendly except the listed codes — their zones and ships are not protected. Enter the code in the transponder too (right-click it). The owner, their team and friendlyPlayers are always friendly.
radar_fcs.msg.transponder_locked: Someone else's transponder: only the owner, their team and operators see and change its settings
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.title: IFF Transponder
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.mode.sublevel: Selection: the sublevel it stands on
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.hint_sublevel: Friendly: the whole Sable / Create Aeronautics ship (or Create contraption) the transponder stands on and everything within it: mobs, players, vehicles, projectiles.
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.hint_sublevel_: The transponder is not on a sublevel: in this mode it protects nothing. Put it on a ship or choose "radius".
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.hint_radius: Friendly: everything within the radius: mobs (hostile too), players, vehicles, contraptions, projectiles, ships. On a ship the ship itself is friendly too and the zone moves with it.
radar_fcs.tooltip.memory: In a fire control's radar network (via a link) adds %s more entries to each of its lists (target whitelist and blacklist, IFF codes). Needs power (FE)
radar_fcs.memory.on: Memory block online: +%s entries to the lists of the network's fire controls
radar_fcs.memory.off: No power: the memory block needs %s FE/t
radar_fcs.report.no_energy: NO POWER: the fire control needs %s FE/t
radar_fcs.report.memory: Memory: %s entries per list, memory blocks in the network: %s
radar_fcs.monitor.no_energy: No power: the monitor is off
radar_fcs.gui.list_no_memory: Inactive: not enough memory. Add a memory block to the network (+16 entries) or remove the entry
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.mode.sublevel_: Selection: sublevel and distance from it
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.hint_combined: Friendly: the ship the transponder stands on and everything within the distance from its bounds: escorts, mobs, players, projectiles.
radar_fcs.transponder_gui.hint_combined_: The transponder is not on a sublevel: in this mode it protects a sphere of the given radius around itself.
